name: code_review
description: Reviews a set of code changes (diff or file list) against project conventions, architecture rules, and best practices. Returns actionable comments graded by severity (critical/major/minor/nit). Embodies Engineering Law 12: never fabricate issues.

inputs.name: changes
inputs.description: [{ file_path, operation, content or diff }] from the code engine output.

inputs.name: review_profile
inputs.description: Review style: thorough (everything) | safety (security+correctness only) | style (conventions only).

outputs.name: review
outputs.description: { overall_score_0to100, comments: [{file, line, severity, issue, suggestion, category}], critical_count, major_count, pass: bool }

error_codes.message: Could not parse the diff or file content.
error_codes.recovery: Skip the file and continue; list unparsed files.

error_codes.message: Comment count exceeds the configured max_comments.
error_codes.recovery: Return top N by severity; fold the rest into a summary bucket.

examples: changes from code_generation output -> review with 3 critical (security), 5 major (convention), pass=false until critical fixed.
